verdict.rationale: The hosted MCP server supports OAuth, so an agent can be granted access through browser approval instead of being handed a copied credential. That gives the agent its own delegated credential, but nothing in the evidence says the grant can be scoped or limited to least privilege. Missing for 10: documented permission scopes or read-only/limited tokens, per-agent token creation and revocation, project-level restriction of agent credentials, and independent corroboration.
